bio: Not only does this 18C hotel offer a comfortable stay (opt for one of the newer guestrooms), it is also a popular modern take on a rural restaurant. Diners are waited on by a friendly front-of-house team in an attractive modern setting with a rustic touch. The food is flavoursome, fresh and seasonal. The main courses are also available in smaller portions. In summer, make a beeline for the gorgeous terrace to the rear of the building....
